counterparty: Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust
description: Acquisition of a 75% effective interest in Top Ryde City Shopping Centre, a well-established freehold regional shopping centre in the City of Ryde, Sydney, Australia, for A$393.8 million from Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust; completed 19 December 2025, marking Keppel REIT's first pure-play retail asset and strategic diversification into the retail segment.

description: Acquisition of an additional one-third interest in Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3, a premium Grade A office tower in the heart of Singapore's Central Business District, at an agreed property value of S$1,453.0 million, from Sageland Private Limited; completed 31 December 2025, raising Keppel REIT's aggregate interest in the asset to two-third.
